newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Cenbank bond rate rises to 2.6149 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Cenbank bond rate rises to 2.6149 pct.

text.p: Brazil's benchmark overnight rate rose to 2.6149 percent a month, from 2.6140 percent last week, at today's 7.5 billion reais sale of 56-day Central Bank Bonds (BBC), dealers said.
The auction's result was in line with market expectations, they added.
The 56-day bonds will mature on January 1. Today's auction is expected to add 244 million reais to the banking system, with 7.5 billion reais in old bonds coming due Wednesday.
